section.title: Default Initialization
section.content:
The default construtor initialize the class with the following default value:
AcceptNull: false
IsPrimaryKey: false
IsUnique: false
UseDatabaseIdentity:false
Length: -1
DataType: DataType.Undefined
DefaultValue: String.Empty
enumConvertionType: EnumConvertionType.ByName
EnumType: Null
